title: Mid-Atlantic Nature Atlas
text:
Approach

Bulk iNaturalist research-grade observations from GBIF, filtered to MD, PA, and DC.
Weekly effort-adjusted seasonality index: a group’s share of observations in a given week, relative to all observations that week. Values above 1 mean the group is over-represented that week compared with overall observer effort.
Next: compare with eBird for birds to see where the platforms disagree on timing.

title: Mid-Atlantic Nature Atlas
text:
Pages

Seasonality: effort, effort-adjusted heatmap, peak weeks.
Plant phenology: flowering windows for common species, from iNaturalist annotations.

title: Mid-Atlantic Nature Atlas
text:
Data and caveats
Data are community-contributed and reflect where and when people observe, not a systematic survey. Observer identities are anonymized with a one-way hash.
